messages:
erin h: Heads-up  I had emergency laparoscopy yesterday. Hospital billed both me and my spouse's insurer and they're asking me to provide primary insurer details/COB form before discharge. I thought my plan at Redwood was primary.

benji: Oof hope you're ok, @erin h. If your spouse also has employer coverage, carriers will look at coordination of benefits rules (birthday rule, active employee, etc.). Do you know if your spouse was listed as primary on their employer plan?

erin h: My spouse was enrolled as primary at their company. I added them as dependent on Redwood last month but didn't realize that could flip primary. Hospital billing says they need an insurer-to-insurer COB form or a provider letter confirming primary payer.

maya l: We can help. Two paths: 1) generate a standard COB declaration we can fax/email to the hospital and notify both carriers; 2) open a claims-assisted COB coordination case with our carrier to get an insurer determination. For discharge, the hospital usually accepts a provisional COB fax showing both policies and member IDs.

claims-admin: I can draft the provisional COB fax now. Need: spouse full name, spouse DOB, spouse insurer name, spouse member ID (or employer name). Also need hospital fax/email.

erin h: Spouse: Sam Huang, DOB 1987-02-10, Employer: Glimmer Apps, member ID G-55612. Hospital fax: 206-555-4001 (Providence South ER Billing).

people-ops-bot: Automated note: For COB coordination, provide both member IDs and policy group numbers where possible. If the spouse's insurer requires primary verification, we will submit an insurer-to-insurer request. Typical carrier response: 5-10 business days.

claims-admin: Drafted COB provisional fax: 

```
Redwood Inference Benefits Office
Re: Coordination of Benefits - Erin Harper (EmpID R-20987)
Patient: Erin Harper (DOB: 1991-11-02)
Primary/Other Insurer: Glimmer Apps (Member: Sam Huang, ID: G-55612)
Redwood Plan: Redwood Core PPO (Group: 879453) - Member ID: R-20987-3
Note: Dependent enrollment and COB info provided. Request provisional acceptance of primary/secondary claim routing pending insurer-to-insurer determination.
```

claims-admin: Faxing to 206-555-4001 now and copying hospital billing email: billing@providence-south.example. Also notifying Redwood carrier and adding a COB ticket #COB-1167.

erin h: They accepted the provisional fax and discharged me, but they said if carrier adjudication finds Redwood primary they may re-bill. What should I expect?

maya l: If our carrier rules you primary, the hospital will rebill Redwood and refund/dispute with the other insurer. If carrier finds the spouse's plan primary, Redwood will coordinate secondary coverage for eligible amounts. Either way, keep the itemized hospital bill and any EOBs from both insurers. We'll track this under COB-1167.

people-ops-bot: Case COB-1167 created. Action items: 1) Submit insurer-to-insurer COB request to Glimmer Apps carrier (we have contact: providernetwork@glimmercarrier.example) 2) Monitor adjudication, update Erin and hospital billing. Estimated carrier latency: 5-10 business days.

benji: Also FYI: if you want to avoid future confusion, we can set primary on file depending on employer rules. HR usually defaults to active employee plan as primary; if you want Redwood to be primary we can submit supporting paperwork but it's subject to carrier rules. DM me if you want us to start that.

erin h: Thanks all  I'm on pain meds but stable. Appreciate the quick COB fax. :heart:
